notes.purpose: Production-build Lighthouse CI contract for the quality-gate-app dashboard.
notes.route: Audit exactly http://localhost/ from the compiled ./dist directory.
notes.runs: Collect three comparable runs and score the worst case, never an average or median.
notes.categories: Measure categories:performance and categories:accessibility only; do not skip audits.
notes.lcp: largest-contentful-paint must stay at or below the protected millisecond budget.
notes.aggregation: Every assertion uses error severity and pessimistic aggregation so one bad run fails the gate.
